status: B1-B6 approved with the design (design-proposal 3.1) and confirmed with the not-planned/duplicate guard on 2026-10-16 (realignment decision 10). Mechanics enforced by New-CohesionWorkItem.ps1 (tooling E5, E7, E10). Extensions X1/X2 await sign-off and are not rules.

rules.text: A defect in behaviour a closed item delivered is filed as a native sub-issue of that closed item - not of its epic, not of its category.
Closed means GitHub state CLOSED with reason COMPLETED. Board Status 'In review' is open: a defect found there is in-scope rework on the open item (Origin DiscoveredTask), not a bug child.
rules.mechanics: A parent closed as NOT_PLANNED or DUPLICATE delivered nothing, so nothing regressed against it: file under the owning category.

rules.text: Attach to the most specific delivered item whose acceptance criteria the behaviour violates - the leaf, never the feature above it, never an epic or a category.
rules.mechanics: When that item cannot take a child (eight-level nesting or 100 sub-issues), attach to the nearest ancestor that can and name the leaf in the body.

rules.text: If no delivered item's criteria are violated, it is not a bug child: it is an ordinary item under the owning category. Shipping it adds criteria; it does not restore them.
Never reopen a delivered item to carry a defect: the board's 'Item reopened -> In progress' workflow would take it off the delivered record.
A bug child of a bug is legitimate: a regression in a fix attaches to the item that shipped the fix.

pendingExtensions.text: Any regression with an identifiable breaking change attaches to the item that shipped that change, taking precedence over B3; the violated item is named 'Relates to #N'.
pendingExtensions.decideAt: the post-#1168 backfill, against real cases (realignment decision 10)

pendingExtensions.text: When two closed items' criteria are both violated, the parent is the one that owns the code being changed (taxonomy R2); the other is named 'Relates to #N'.

filing.label: bug
filing.wbs: <parentWbs>.NN where NN = highest existing direct child (open and closed) + 1; no reserved range

roadmap: A bug is placed like any item (inherited tier, else Wave/Priority window); a delivered parent gets hasOpenDefect; tier milestones count open defect descendants; no Rework lane, no notch. Source: roadmap-model.md 7.3.
